name: Mokuran Shuuji
source:
"I know you better than anyone. Leave it to me!"

An "otokonoko" who likes to dress up in girls' fashion. His good looks often make him popular among men, but he is a real man on the inside. 

He's learned Capoeira and Jeet Kune Do, and his kicking skills are first-rate, so he often kicks away persistent men. As a matter of fact, he is also popular with women, but he keeps this fact a secret for some reason.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/mokuran_shuji.html]official website[/url]]
